intro: Europe's main fintech hub for Russian speakers, a warm Mediterranean climate, and English in everyday life. But expensive rent and difficult banking.
climate: Mediterranean — hot dry summers around +35°C, mild winters around +15°C. The sunniest days in Europe — over 320 a year.
mentality: Cypriot-Greek hospitality with an English administrative culture. A very open and safe society.
language_note: Greek is the official language, with English used everywhere. Russian is common in the large Russian-speaking districts of Limassol and Paphos.
visa_note: Pro Visa for 90 days of tourism. Residence permit — Category F (financially independent), Employment Permit (via work), or Permanent Residence through investments from 300,000 euros.
